title: Trick-or-Terror
description: As Lynn Steller and her nephew Ronald lie motionless in their kitchen, Lynn's girlfriend arrives home; at first, the woman thinks this is an elaborate Halloween prank, but when she looks again, she discovers a scene that will haunt her forever.

title: FEDS
description:
S02 E05 — Gangbuster
A series of unsolved shootings and murders across Southern Florida leave a community terrorized under the threat of an unknown gang; rookie FBI Special Agent Jessica Box makes it her mission to identify and dismantle this deadly crew.

title: FEDS
description:
S02 E06 — Hired To Kill
Over two years, a killer shoots multiple people dead in Philadelphia; the killer's identity and motive remain unclear; the FBI and a dedicated task force soon uncover that they are dealing with a real-life hitman who calls himself the Real John Wick.

title: FEDS
description:
S02 E03 — We Sell Babies
The Always Hope adoption center, run by Tara Lynn Lee, falls under suspicion of multiple families who are all left heartbroken after their adoptions fall through; the FBI begins to uncover a heartbreaking multi-state scam like no other.

title: FEDS
description:
S02 E04 — Inside Job
In Connecticut, an employee arrives at his bank with a bomb strapped to him, claiming he will die if not given money; in Tennessee, bank employees begin robbing their own banks, each claiming they have been held hostage and forced into the crime.

title: Body Cam
description:
S04 E04 — No Surrender
A car crash ignites a fireball that threatens a Maryland officer making a traffic stop; an armed burglar hides in a closet and officers must smoke him out; an officer confronts a wanted felon who pulls a gun on him.

title: Body Cam
description:
S04 E09 — Manhunt
In Colorado, a home invasion leads to a car chase and gunfight with police, resulting in a fatality; in New Mexico, a known criminal holds up a convenience store and then takes officers on a car chase.

title: Body Cam
description:
S04 E01 — Life in Ruins
SWAT tears down a house to arrest two brothers wanted for murder; a high-speed pursuit ends when a crash entangles an officer's car in live electrical cables; a DWI driver hits a goods train carrying explosive chemicals.

title: Body Cam
description:
S04 E05 — Smoking Gun
A single bullet to the chest kills a man, it looks like a murder, but the inquiry takes a turn; a high-speed pursuit turns into rescue mission as the chase ends in a fiery crash.

title: Body Cam
description:
S05 E05 — Fired Up
Police race to an armed robbery and face a hail of shotgun pellets; a gas explosion lifts the roof off an apartment building, engulfing officers in a fireball; in Georgia, a man fights for his life in a wrecked SUV.

title: Body Cam
description:
S05 E03 — Wrong Turn
In Ohio, police try to rescue a woman who is in a sinking car, which puts an officer's life in danger; in Florida, a high-speed pursuit ends in a swamp, where the suspect shoots at police and escapes.

title: See No Evil
description:
S12 E10 — The Wrong Woman
In 2017, Alisha Canales-McGuire is shot dead at her sister's house; evidence points to a targeted attack, but detectives can find no motive until CCTV and social media lead to a tangled murder plot and a twist of fate.

title: See No Evil
description:
S12 E09 — Not a Social Person
A motorist shoots dead Whitney Gray while she shops with her young kids and teenage niece; detectives follow a trail of CCTV to track down the suspect car and discover that the killer is on the run and carrying a stash of weapons.

title: See No Evil
description:
S11 E04 — The Devil's Bathtub
In 2016, father Craig Rideout is reported missing after a strange home intrusion; within hours, police find a body matching Craig's description fifty miles away; using surveillance footage and forensics, detectives unravel an unbelievable plot.

title: See No Evil
description:
S11 E02 — Tapes Don't Lie
33-year-old Michael Scott is shot dead on the streets of downtown Baltimore; detectives are in a race against time to find the gunman before he strikes again; a trail of cameras lining the city's streets and buses may lead police to the killer.

title: See No Evil
description:
S11 E07 — Toying With Us
In 2013, someone murders 35-year-old assistant manager Larry Wells in his office at Toys R Us; a disguised knife-wielding man appears on camera stalking the store; police must now follow the trail of surveillance footage to track down the killer.

title: See No Evil
description:
S12 E02 — Nowhere Girl
In 2020, 21-year-old Dioneth Lopez goes missing while on a trip to visit friends; her body turns up in the woodlands of Washington State; she is treated as a Jane Doe until detectives find surveillance footage that pieces together her final hour.

title: See No Evil
description:
S14 E07 — The Trophy Collector
In Baltimore, a killer strangles two women to death less than a week apart; investigators piece together the clues from CCTV footage from the locations of the two homicides to reveal a suspect with designs on becoming a serial killer.

title: A Body in the Basement
description:
S03 E02 — Her Last Steps
Days before Christmas, a suspected home invasion stuns a quiet Connecticut neighborhood, leaving a mother of two dead in the basement and her husband badly injured; investigators soon discover that this case may not be what it first appears.

title: Homicide Hunter: American Detective
description:
S01 E01 — Fourteen Stories Down
After a second body turns up, investigators change their minds about an apparent suicide, attributing it to foul play.

title: Killer Confessions: Case Files of a Texas Ranger
description:
S01 E08 — A Devil Always Lies
When 28-year-old mother Samantha McNorton vanishes without a trace in Wise County, Texas, police hit a dead end until Ranger Jim Holland steps in and launches a 24-hour whirlwind investigation, determined to uncover the truth.

description:
S02 E03 — In Too Deep
Businesspeople John and Liz Calvert vanish in 2008 from Hilton Head, S.C.; friends, investigators and local reporters are shocked and in disbelief that a couple could disappear without a trace in such a peaceful place.

title: Hometown Homicide
description:
S02 E06 — Unsafe Anywhere
Joel Larson is shot to death in a safe haven community for gay people in the 1990s Minneapolis; two more shootings terrorize people in the community as they realize a serial killer lives among them.

title: 48 Hours
description:
S38 E13 — The Blackout Murder of Livye Lewis
A young woman is found shot in her car on the side of a road with her ex-boyfriend bloodied and disoriented nearby; the boyfriend claims he can't remember what happened.

title: 48 Hours on ID
description:
Dead Girls Don't Talk
Masked men abandon two women outside L.A. hospitals, sparking a hunt for the predator behind their deaths.

title: The Rocky Mountain Mortician Murder
description:
S01 E01 — Brothers, Sons and Lovers
Family members find beloved funeral director Byron Griffy brutally murdered; as investigators delve into Byron's life, they uncover startling revelations about his grandson, handyman and two local celebrity brothers.

title: The Rocky Mountain Mortician Murder
description:
S01 E02 — Closets Hide Skeletons
Police discover dark secrets about prominent brothers, including stolen coins; one brother's affair with a prison guard reveals a hidden relationship before ending in death.

title: The Rocky Mountain Mortician Murder
description:
S01 E03 — Burying the Guilty
The trial for Byron Griffey's murder begins and an investigator uncovers numerous new leads and suppressed evidence that casts doubt on the eventual conviction; a surprise sentence outrages many and leaves questions unanswered.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E18 — Evilness Inside My Head
An emotional 911 call comes in from a young man claiming he just found his mother and dog murdered in their home; once his interview with detectives begins, they uncover a parasitic psychopath who will do anything to get away with the crime.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E19 — That's When My Nightmare Started
A small SD card contains horrifying images and videos of a woman's murder; when someone gives it to Anchorage police, detectives come face-to-face with a sexual psychopath who has a shocking tale to tell.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E12 — The Biggest Adrenaline Rush
When detectives find an elderly woman dead after someone stuffs her in her own closet, they know they are not dealing with a normal killer. Instead, they discover the culprit is a troubled teenager with a fantasy to rape and kill.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E13 — That's What You Do With a Knife
When officers arrive at a suburban home regarding a felonious assault, they find a bloodied and lifeless woman in her minivan.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E14 — Can You Count Bullets?
Police find a woman shot to death in a car, and the prime suspect is her dangerous psychopathic boyfriend.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E15 — Everybody Believes in Bad People
A gruesome discovery in a Florida landfill reveals two young psychopathic parents with parasitic tendencies and a disturbing plan for a double murder.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E16 — Every Time Was Like Christmas
Between 1991 and 2001, several violent sexual assaults occur along I-85 between Wyoming and Utah; the cases remain cold until almost two decades later, when advancements in DNA technology lead detectives straight to a psychopathic sexual predator.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E17 — He Got Such a Rush From It
Police charge a son and his wife with the murder of his father until a tip comes from a woman claiming her ex-husband and his friend admitted to the brutal killing; detectives interview the new suspects and uncover a pair of cold-blooded psychopaths.

title: Murder in the Heartland
description:
S06 E05 — Orders of Protection
A tip comes in from an unexpected Willard, Mo., resident that leads to the final resting ground of missing newlyweds Russell and Rebecca Porter.

title: Murder in the Heartland
description:
S07 E04 — The Gravel Pit Murders
In Howard City, Michigan, detectives investigate a night of horror that ends with the shooting of beloved couple Robert and Norma Bean in a gravel pit; local tips provide alarming new clues, revealing the shocking timeline of their final hours.

title: Murder in the Heartland
description:
S07 E03 — Last Shift at Pirate's Cove
College junior Emily Murray, a popular religious studies major, goes missing late one night after quitting her job at a local bar; a month later, someone finds her body in a remote trailer, leading police to another gruesome discovery.

title: Murder in the Heartland
description:
S06 E02 — Hunting a Killer
In rural Missouri, a hunter is found slain in his car near the popular deer trails; this could be a hunting accident gone wrong, or something more sinister.

title: Murder in the Heartland
description:
S06 E06 — Killer Casino
Neighborly casino runner Lori Bray is found dead in the woods in the small town of Laurel, Mont.; the community must wonder if it was a consequence of her good nature at work or if someone from her past came back to bite.

title: A Killer Trick-or-Treater
description: Doreen and Charles Erbert live a charmed life with their 4-year-old daughter Deanna in San Jose, Calif.; then everything comes to a violent end on Halloween night when Doreen is stabbed to death by a masked trick-or-treater.

title: The Body in the Cornfield
description: When a woman gives her 12-year-old son, Billy Huddleston, permission to ride his new bicycle around town, she has no idea this will be the last time she ever sees him alive; an all-out search for the missing boy turns up a body in a cornfield.

title: The Texas Axe Murder
description: A selfless woman who often welcomes needy people into her Lancaster, Texas, home pays a bloody price when a man with a hatchet brutalizes her, her invalid mother, and a houseguest who was in the wrong place at the wrong time.

title: A Killer Clown Strikes
description: In Florida, a wealthy small businesswoman is shot in the face by a clown delivering flowers and balloons; this shocking crime goes unsolved for 27 years.

title: Dead Silent
description:
S03 E05 — Taken for a Ride
Reeling from a recent breakup, 23-year-old Jacey McWilliams is down in the dumps until she meets a hot, new man; just as they're about to take their relationship to the next level, it takes a horrific turn.

title: Dead Silent
description:
S03 E01 — Picture of Evil
A picture-perfect dinner for two dissolves into a nightmare for college sophomore Dominique Nicky Hurd and a classmate after they become the targets of a deranged predator.

title: On the Case With Paula Zahn
description:
S23 E09 — No Escape
A young woman's disappearance marks the beginning of a heartbreaking murder mystery; a clue discovered by a child could be the key to catching his mother's killer.

title: On the Case With Paula Zahn
description:
S23 E14 — A Cracked Alibi
If investigators can't find the crack in their suspect's seemingly airtight alibi, a cold-blooded killer will elude justice.

title: The Cult Behind the Killer: The Andrea Yates Story
description:
S01 E01 — Indoctrination
After Andrea Yates' horrifying act, her dark preoccupation emerges; a secretive cult, twisted teachings, and followers drawn into a growing web of control.

title: The Cult Behind the Killer: The Andrea Yates Story
description:
S01 E02 — The Horror Within
Woroniecki's teachings reportedly isolate followers and equate salvation with submission; this ideology is linked to Andrea Yates, who committed an act that shocked the nation.

title: The Cult Behind the Killer: The Andrea Yates Story
description:
S01 E03 — Revelation
Andrea Yates faces two trials in the aftermath of the drownings, exposing the preacher's lingering influence; as Woroniecki deflects blame onto Rusty, a juror quietly reveals that his teachings shaped the verdict, raising questions of accountability.

title: Toxic
description:
S02 E03 — Blame It On Daddy
When Jason marries Andria, he believes her story of survival and struggle; as their marriage collapses, her web of lies grows - false accusations, fabricated abuse claims and a campaign to destroy him, culminating in an armed home invasion.

title: Toxic
description:
S02 E04 — A Living Nightmare
Mandy marries a man twice her age and their relationship quickly turns suffocating and volatile; as the abuse escalates, she searches for answers until the truth emerges, and she fights to be believed and hold him accountable.

title: Toxic
description:
S02 E05 — The Chosen One
When a teenage girl in a tightly controlled religious community falls prey to her charismatic pastor, she's told it is love; years later, she realizes it is abuse and takes on those in the church who would rather destroy her than face the truth.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S12 E03 — Sleeping With the Enemy
When Sarita Anderson begins feeling ill, she thinks it's just the flu at first; she never suspects that the man pretending to love and nurse her back to health is actually the monster responsible.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S11 E01 — Locked in the Closet
Alice Jenkins locks Jesse Ewing in a closet; Jesse realizes that if he and his siblings do not find a way to escape, they will surely die.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S11 E06 — Keeping My Brother's Secret
When Steven Crittenden confesses to his brother, Bryant, and then swears him to secrecy, Bryant faces the toughest decision of his life: whether to keep the secret and risk letting a murderer get away with it or tell the truth and betray his family.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S11 E03 — I Will Always Be Scared of Him
From the moment Deborah Williamson meets her stepson, David Shafer, she feels something unsettling about him; when her warnings about his frightening behavior go unheeded, the devastation he ultimately wreaks goes beyond her imagination.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S11 E08 — Divorce? Never. Murder? Maybe.
When Vernon Jensen's ex-wife proves how far she'll go to get him back, his family is fractured beyond repair, and the little girl who was to be his stepdaughter never sees him again; now Jade Scotton is an adult and wants answers only Vernon has.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S11 E02 — What if He Gets Out?
When Amy Chesler calls 911 to report what her brother, Jesse Winnick, has confessed to, she doesn't know whether to believe him; Jesse's always been a liar, and Amy doesn't understand what he is capable of until she walks in and sees it for herself.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S19 E07 — The Granny Killer
Nora Lapella escapes her abusive husband, Edwin Mike Kaprat, with her two sons; police arrest him for killing at least five people and suspect him in additional deaths; only then does she realize how lucky she and her children are to be alive.

title: What Happened in the Haight House?
description: For nearly two decades, Tausha Haight endures emotional and psychological abuse from her seemingly perfect husband, Michael, who hides a darker reality; when she fights to leave, escalating red flags put Tausha and her five children in danger.

title: Toxic
description:
S02 E06 — Love and Rage
Yeardley Love is days from graduation when her UVA lacrosse player boyfriend, George Huguely, breaks into her room and kills her; Elizabeth Chambers examines the warning signs, missed intervention, and the legacy her family builds from tragedy.

Death Before Dishonor
Detectives rush to a Kansas City bar after a mass shooting leaves the entire country reeling; with suspects on the run and chilling footage emerging, investigators race to uncover the truth before more blood is shed.

title: Real PD: Kansas City

S01 E04 — Run to Grandma
Four separate gas stations are violently robbed at gun point by a masked man in one night; detectives race to catch the robber and get justice for the terrified local community.
